## What's new

### Rename agents and terminals
Right-click an agent card's title, a terminal, a pane header or a console tab to rename it. The name is kept when Larvyn restarts.

### Agents say what they're doing
Claude Code and Codex now tell Larvyn when they're working, waiting for you or done, instead of Larvyn guessing from their output. An agent waiting on a permission prompt is flagged for your attention, and a finished one shows **Done**.

### One step to connect your agents
Settings → Agents → **Set up agents** now installs the Larvyn skill and the Larvyn MCP server for every agent you have: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Windsurf and OpenCode. **Remove** takes both out.

Run **Set up agents** again after updating to get the new state hooks and the MCP server.
